decisions.reason: The answer-layer change applies to answers written for the curated questions but does not alter the curation actions, criteria, coverage, or goals owned by this Requirement.
Integrating answer frameworks into mandatory framing guidance does not change the permitted recommendations for merging, removing, or introducing categories and chapters.
The AI chapter is explicitly a basic non-question-and-answer chapter, so the revised answer-layer structure does not apply to or change its state.
The answer-layer Requirement independently governs answers in new question-and-answer chapters; it does not change this chapter's subject, format, or question-count policy.
The pre-interview preparation chapter is explicitly basic material without a question-and-answer format, so the answer-layer modification does not affect it.
Although this is a new question-and-answer chapter, the separate answer-layer Requirement supplies its answer structure without changing this chapter's focus, format, or question-count policy.
The revised answer-layer structure applies alongside this chapter Requirement but does not alter its subject, question-and-answer format, or question-count rule.
Integrating frameworks into framing guidance does not change the international-perspective markets, integration approach, opening note, or country-specific guidance.
The answer-layer modification does not change which proposed content changes require editorial review or the timing and authority of that review.
The answer-layer decision does not alter the authoritative editing artifact, tracked-change method, reference-copy use, or proposed-removal workflow.
The manuscript answer-layer structure does not necessarily modify the types, purpose, or delivery format of the separate companion learning assets.
Changing how answer frameworks are incorporated does not change the complete-book maximum word count or the recorded approximate length of the existing edition.
